comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (33.73%) to L. culinaris defensin C: 12%. GRAVY: -0.816, mol wt: 9275.668, mol formula: C402H609N118O112S11, mol ex coeff: 21745. Activity: active against B. subtilis NBRC13719T (MIC 10 uM). Bacteria-agglutinating:E. coli: Bacteria-agglutinating:S. aureus: the peptide can cause bacteria aggregates. Active against bacteria V. coralliilyticus at low salt condition. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: pET48b(+) vector, Rosetta-gami2(DE3)pLysS-competent cells, fusion expression with thioredoxin, His-tag, IPTG induction, protease cleavage, peptide yield: 10 mg. Host expression: it is activated in response to pathogen infection and secreted into mucus.
title: A coral peptide with bactericidal activity against a global marine pathogen, Vibrio coralliilyticus.
